'''''Forum Geometricorum: A Journal on Classical Euclidean Geometry''''' was a [[peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[open access|open-access]] [[academic journal]] that specialized in mathematical research papers on [[Euclidean geometry]].<ref>{{citation |title=Geometry in Action: A Discovery Approach Using the Geometer's Sketchpad |first=Clark |last=Kimberling |authorlink=Clark Kimberling |publisher=Springer |year=2003 |isbn=9781931914024 |page=111 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=a87y9lWQEBMC&pg=PA111}}.</ref>

Founded in 2001, it was published by [[Florida Atlantic University]] and was indexed by [[Mathematical Reviews]]<ref>{{citation |url=https://www.ams.org/mathscinet/search/journaldoc.html?jc=FORGE |title=Journal Information for "Forum Geometricorum. A Journal on Classical Euclidean Geometry and Related Areas" |work=[[MathSciNet]] |publisher=American Mathematical Society |accessdate=2015-08-26}}.</ref> and {{lang|de|[[Zentralblatt MATH]]}}.<ref>{{citation |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/?q=Forum+Geometricorum |title= zbMath - Forum Geometricorum - A Journal on Classical Euclidean Geometry and Related Areas |publisher=[[European Mathematical Society]] |accessdate=2020-05-28}}.</ref> Its founding editor-in-chief was [[Paul Yiu]], a professor of mathematics at Florida Atlantic.<ref name=l2e/>

In 2019, Forum Geometricorum published what was later announced to be its final issue, and stopped accepting submissions, after the retirement of Yiu.<ref name=l2e>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/202010/rnoti-p1485.pdf|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|title=Letter to the Editor|first=Bogdan D.|last=Suceavă|author-link=Bogdan Suceavă|page=1485|date=November 2020|volume=67|issue=10}}</ref> 

Prior issues are still available. Volumes for 2001 to 2009 can be accessed as a single searchable file (see below). Individual articles up to 2019 are available from Internet Archive (see below).
